definitions.gloss: fixed form, standard pattern, set format
definitions.explanation: A predetermined or standardized form, pattern, or template. Used for established formats in writing, communication, or other structured activities.

examples.japanese: {定型|ていけい}⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{登録|とうろく}する→登録する：25227_tourokusuru⟧。
⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{定型|ていけい}⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{返信|へんしん}→返信：14350_henshin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I replied using a standard email template.

examples.japanese: ⟦{俳句|はいく}→俳句：00083_haiku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{五|ご}{七|しち}{五|ご}→五七五：22868_goshichigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{定型|ていけい}{詩|し}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: Haiku is a fixed-form poem with a 5-7-5 structure.

notes:
USAGE:
{定型|ていけい} is used as a modifier (often with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or as a compound) to describe things that follow a standard pattern. It is common in business and IT contexts for templates and boilerplate text.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {定型|ていけい}⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧ — template phrase, boilerplate text
- {定型|ていけい}{詩|し} — fixed-form poetry
- {定型|ていけい}{業務|ぎょうむ} — routine tasks, standardized work
- {定型|ていけい}{外|がい} — non-standard, irregular

SIMILAR WORDS:
Do not confuse with the homophone ⟦{提携|ていけい}→提携：05773_teikei⟧ (cooperation, partnership), which has a completely different meaning.
